newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Costello sees sustained Australian economic growth.
newsitem.headline: Costello sees sustained Australian economic growth.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday he wanted to set the country up for decades of sustained economic growth.
"What we want to do is set Australia up for a higher sustained growth period," Costello told Adelaide radio 5DN.

He said the government wanted to avoid the "boom-bust rollercoaster" by having long-term economic growth to cut unemployment. Unemployment was at 8.7 percent in April and the government has forecast it to fall to 8.0 percent by June 1998.
"What my aim is, or the plan of our government is, is to get growth up and to keep it there for decades," Costello said.
